hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); file=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,sys; print((json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path") or "")' 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$file" == *.swift ]]; then cd /Users/jeong-ilin/study/clawde && swift build 2>&1 | tail -20; fi

INPUT=$(cat); file=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,sys; print((json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path") or "")' 2>/dev/null); case "$file" in */.build/*|*/airuncat.app/*) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"빌드 산출물 — Sources/를 수정하세요: %s"}}' "$file";; esac

INPUT=$(cat); file=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,sys; print((json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path") or "")' 2>/dev/null); case "$file" in */.claude/projects/*.jsonl) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"세션 로그는 읽기 전용: %s"}}' "$file";; esac
